title: How Does Your Microwave Actually Heat Food? The Magnetron Myth

scenes.text: Your 900‑Watt microwave uses a magnetron that some say turns food into plasma.

scenes.label: Microwave makes plasma
scenes.text: A common belief is that microwaves create plasma inside the oven to heat meals.

scenes.label: Radio‑frequency heating
scenes.text: Microwaves generate radio‑frequency waves that cause water molecules to vibrate, producing heat—no plasma is formed in normal operation.

scenes.label: Molecule Vibration
scenes.text: Heat comes from molecular vibration, not plasma.
Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: Debunk the plasma myth and learn the real physics behind microwave ovens. Follow us for clear, factual tech breakdowns.
